raw_comment:
I noticed that most of the droughts are located near the middle of the US. For the most part in the south and the north. Ohio has the moist extreme drought out of all states and has the largest area of common droughts. 

I wonder why these droughts occur and why they occur in these specific locations? Like droughts in upper michigan there is a lot of fresh water yet there are some droughts, I figured there would be more rain. I wonder if the droughts make people not want to live there, a lot of the areas have low populations. 

This affects my community because it is my country around me experiencing droughts. 

“Drought levels around the US”
